title: Slime to Tall Trees Explained Simply | PUC Biology Class 11
description:
Green slime on the water tank, velvet moss on the compound wall and a tall tree by the road are all plants. Diya asks what actually changed on the way from water slime to tall trees.

You will meet the five plant groups from algae to angiosperms, look at one labelled plant from each (with a look inside a fern stem at xylem and phloem), and run a live tracker of four trends: the body, the pipes, the dominant phase and the need for water. Then heterospory in Selaginella and Salvinia as the step towards seeds, bryophytes vs pteridophytes side by side, a pause and think check, a worked matching example, the exam trap, an original NEET assertion and reason question, a recap card and three questions to answer. This is Episode 30 of our PUC Biology series.

Made for PUC (Karnataka), CBSE Class 11 and NEET students.

In this video:
